properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: The HMAC secret every service shares. Only auth-service signs with it (JwtService); every service, including auth-service itself, verifies with it offline (JwtVerifier). Base64 or base64url, with or without padding.

properties.name: classroom.security.public-paths
properties.description: Comma-separated paths JwtAuthFilter lets through without a token. Each service declares its own: only auth-service's list needs to include the login route.

properties.name: classroom.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated origins SecurityConfig's CORS filter admits. No default on purpose: shipping a fallback would mean a forgotten override silently trusts an origin nobody chose.

properties.name: classroom.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Whether CORS admits cookies/credentials on cross-origin requests.

properties.name: classroom.cors.max-age
properties.description: How long, in seconds, a browser may cache a CORS preflight response.

properties.name: classroom.openapi.title
properties.description: This service's own Swagger title (OpenApiConfig). Every service picks up that shared bean via @ComponentScan, so without a value here it would show booking-service's title instead of its own.

properties.name: classroom.openapi.description
properties.description: This service's own Swagger description (OpenApiConfig), for the same reason as classroom.openapi.title.
properties.defaultValue: API REST per la gestione di prenotazioni aule, corsi e notifiche

properties.name: classroom.public-api-url
properties.description: The base URL declared in every service's OpenAPI spec (OpenApiConfig). Always the gateway, never the service's own port: the endpoints only exist under /api/**, reachable through the gateway either way, and leaving this unset lets springdoc guess it instead - wrongly, whenever the spec was fetched through a proxied path, such as the aggregated Swagger UI's /docs/<service>/v3/api-docs route.
